inference_note: Rows outside A2 cite ArchiMate 3.2 / TOGAF 10, which are login-gated. Each carries an `inference`: the ArchiMate concept of both ends, the generic-metamodel pattern the row instantiates, the reasoning, SDEM's inference confidence (high = direct instance of a core rule; medium = derived or through an SDEM extension; low = weak or unmatched pattern), and the independent test to run. The test uses a public implementation of the specification's relationship matrix: the open-source Archi tool (github.com/archimatetool/archi, file relationships.xml under com.archimatetool.model) encodes, per source and target concept, the permitted relationship letters (c composition, g aggregation, i assignment, r realization, v serving, a access, f flow, t triggering, s specialization, o association). Verifying against it needs no Open Group account and reproduces no specification text.
